title: Warm roast pumpkin and chicken salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain home staple: pumpkin, onions, tinned chickpeas, chicken, mustard, honey, apples, watercress and seeds.

supermarket.reason: Everything is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price, and pumpkins are plentiful in early November.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, a bowl and a whisk, with simple roasting and tossing.

works.reason: Pumpkin wedges and chicken breasts roast through in 30 minutes at 200°C, and with the chickpeas, apples and watercress it makes a decent lunch for four with enough dressing.

honest_times.reason: 20 minutes covers peeling and wedging the pumpkin, slicing the onions and apples, whisking the dressing and slicing the chicken, and the 30-minute roast matches the steps.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning, including the lemon and pumpkin seeds, is used, and the steps add nothing unlisted.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm roast pumpkin salad suits a cool early-November lunch, and the pumpkin is the bulk of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner can follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling mix of vegetables, pulses and lean chicken that a family would happily eat.
